description: Bounded configuration for the vision model fallback (babeldoc/magazine/vlm_client.py). Same convention as configs/page_features.json: every numeric parameter carries a '<name>_allowed_range' sibling of the form 'low..high', inclusive on both ends. 'enabled' is the master switch and is false by default, so a run performs no model call and no network request unless it is turned on deliberately. 'api_key_env' names the environment variable the credential is read from at request time; the credential itself is never written to any file in this repository. 'base_url' points at an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. 'model', 'temperature' and 'max_output_tokens' shape a reply and therefore enter the cache key, as does 'render_dpi' through the bytes of the page image it produces; 'base_url', 'api_key_env', 'timeout_seconds' and 'max_retries' do not.
